title: Re-Issue Price of a Lapsed Network or Server Quote
content:
## Price clause

The re-issue of a lapsed Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote re-prices the unit on the re-issue day at the distributor unit cost times one plus the order type's markup percentage, and the re-issued unit price is rounded half up to the cent.

The re-issue total is the quote's units times that re-priced unit, plus the order type's staging fee for each unit, plus its handling fee, plus its rush fee when the quote carries rush, with no re-issue charge. The re-issue total is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

The unit is re-priced first, every charge is then figured, and the units at the re-priced unit and the charges are summed last.

## Order type figures used

| Figure | Network Equipment Order | Server & Storage Build Order |
|---|---|---|
| Markup percentage | 18 | 12 |
| Staging fee per unit | 145.00 | 395.00 |
| Handling fee | 35.00 | 75.00 |
| Rush fee, when the quote carries rush | 150.00 | 350.00 |

The figures are those shown for the order types in the markup and service charge schedules. The units and the distributor unit cost are the quote's own, kept unchanged on re-issue.

## Worked example (hypothetical Network Equipment Order quote of 3 units at a distributor unit cost of 1234.00)

1. Re-priced unit: 1234.00 times 1.18, that is 1456.12.
2. Units: 3 times 1456.12, that is 4368.36.
3. Staging: 3 times 145.00, that is 435.00.
4. Handling: 35.00.
5. Total without rush: 4838.36; with rush, 4988.36.
